notes:
Top-line: EdenByte is an adtech SSP focusing on sub-50ms decisioning for header-bid requests; very cost-sensitive at scale. Evaluation for Redwood Dedicated + Optimize.

Summary of needs (from AE/SE calls):
- Workload: real-time bidding + personalization snippets on ad renders (short prompts, many concurrent requests).
- Targets: p95 latency <= 50ms for inference step (end-to-end decisioning budget ~100ms), steady throughput 3k-8k reqs/s per region during peak. Burst to 20k/s for promotions.
- Cost sensitivity: current infra cost for model serving is top-of-stack concern; want 30-50% unit cost reduction vs current self-hosted.
- Model preferences: open models (Llama3-like family) for price control; willing to test quantized variants and distilled candidates.
- Reliability/routing: multi-region active-active with policy-based routing (latency-first in NA, cost-first in off-peak), fallback to smaller quantized model when capacity constrained.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, KMS integration so customer keeps CMKs for private keys, audit logs retention 1 year, EU residency for EU traffic.

Optimize-specific asks (from ML infra lead):
- Intelligent batching: need guidance on max batch size vs p95 impact for short prompts (<=128 tokens). Recommendation request for sequence length distribution.
- KV/prefix caching: high reuse for identical prefixes (user profile + page context) — want automated prefix cache to reduce per-token compute.
- Quantization: test 4-bit and 8-bit quantization profiles; measuring quality drift on reranking loss metrics.
- Benchmarks: request Redwood-run perf matrix (p50/p95/p99, throughput, GPU utilization, cost per 1M requests) across candidate kernels and quantization configs.
